name: ocr97_night_2_charts_annual_reports
description: Night 2: Chart-heavy annual reports and mixed visual content. Primary stress on gb10_deplot_chart and qwen3-vl:32b for chart-adjacent label extraction and figure-dense layouts. Exposes the routing gap seen in BIS Quarterly (score 72) by testing whether the full GB10 stack improves on similar document types.
